comparison.objective: Refit a foam air-filter element so it seals around its perimeter, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Compliant-part placement, edge tucking, and distributed seal inspection versus rigid fine-tool manipulation, rotary tuning, tightening, and impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Filter seated with a continuous seal versus two quantified safe carriage stops and no collar drift.
comparison.reason: Deformable sealing does not test dynamic damping adjustment. Body and specs are absent, so allowable seal gaps and deformation limits are missing.
